adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the `try/catch` around `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` catches `err` but only logs a fixed string (`console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails")`) and does not log or rethrow the actual error. This means the failure details are effectively swallowed, making debugging/monitoring harder, though it may be an intentional non-fatal behavior rather than a functional defect.
